diagnostic_evidence.quote: For clarity, we use several tensor-product quadrature methods (cf. \cite{shin2017randomized,wu2017randomized}) to approximate all double integrals in this paper.

issues.failure_explanation: No exactness condition for products of the Fourier basis functions is imposed.
